member.name: T:ProtoDesigner.Persistence.Json.JsonProjectRepository
member.summary: Reads and writes projects as canonical, ID-keyed JSON. The written form is deterministic — stable key order, LF line endings, 2-space indent, invariant number formatting — so merges only conflict where two authors touched the same entity.

member.name: M:ProtoDesigner.Persistence.Json.JsonProjectRepository.LoadFromString(System.String)
member.summary: String round-trip. Exposed for tests and for in-memory copies.

member.name: T:ProtoDesigner.Persistence.Json.Serialization.ProjectMigrations
member.summary: One-file-at-a-time migration chain. Adding a version means adding a single migration that goes from N to N+1; the runner applies them in sequence until it reaches . Persisting derived data is prohibited by design, so migrations only shuffle shape and never invent semantics.

member.name: T:ProtoDesigner.Persistence.Json.Serialization.ProjectSerializer
member.summary: Model ↔ . The on-disk shape is flat and ID-keyed so a file entry can map 1:1 to a future DB row without reshaping, and so that unrelated entities never move between saves.
